Name: (AT) Offerings To Sleep
Author: reyphorian
Description:
[center][b][size=5]Behold, an offering.

[/size][/b][size=3]Offerings To Sleep adds various new furniture retextures based on official artworks and visuals from the band Sleep Token. Decorate your home to represent your faction of Feathered Host or House Veridian, immerse yourself into the deep sea, [/size][size=3]or show appreciation for the opening band of the 2025 Even In Arcadia Tour, Thornhill.

[b]Future update plans:[/b]
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Content Patcher version with a custom catalogue[/size]
[*][size=3]compatibility with custom vendor NPCs from Arcadia Weapons (when I actually finish that)[/size]
[/list][b][size=5]
[size=4][u][b]I do not allow[/b][/u][u][b] ANY[/b][/u] of my assets to be used in any generative AI program or Language Learning Model such as Midjourney or chatGPT. [b][u][color=#ff0000]DO NOT UPLOAD TO ANY AI DATASETS.[/color]

[/u][/b][/size][size=3][u]Please reach out to me if you're interested in making a translation![/u][/size]

[size=3][u][b]Disclaimer[/b][/u]: For potential concern by RICO and the RCA Records copyright team, this is mod was made to
express appreciation for Sleep Token as my favorite band. I make no
financial profit off of this mod nor any of the assets used in it, and
have no intention to monetize this mod in any capacity.[/size]
[/size][/b][/center]
